home.heroSubtitle: Find Work, Apprenticeships & Free Training Near You.
home.heroDesc: Whether you do stitching, electrical work, plumbing, driving, cooking, farming or want to learn web development - SkillSetu matches your real abilities to livelihoods with zero rejection.
home.tradesTitle: Built for Every Trade & Digital Aspiration
home.tradesSubtitle: Manual, home-based, technical or vocational - all skills are respected and connected.
home.howItWorksSub: Four simple, dignified steps designed for everyone.
home.step1Desc: No resume needed. Tap visual icons or use voice to share what you can do and what machines you own.
home.step2Desc: Answer 5 practical questions. No one fails; we place you at Beginner, Intermediate or Skilled level.
home.step3Desc: See nearby jobs, apprenticeships, and home contracts with bus routes, fare, and clear 'Why this matches you' reasons.
home.step4Desc: Follow free online and local ITI training sorted free-first, with Mudra loan and PM Vishwakarma guidance.
home.bannerText: Need help in Marathi or Hindi? Call or WhatsApp our helpline at 9822011223
home.footerNote: SkillSetu is a prototype dedicated to empowering rural and low-income communities. All data shown is sample data.
